question: Who was the Chairperson of the sports committee for the National Sports Award 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Justice Mukundakam Sharma__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mukundakam Sharma** is a judge and attorney from India.
 
• He was a member of the Indian Supreme Court.
 
• On November 1, the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports held a ceremony to present the National Sports Awards 2020 trophies to each winner.
 
• Retired Justice Mukundakam Sharma, was chosen to serve as the committee's chair.
 
• Virender Sehwag (cricket), Sardar Singh (hockey), Monalisa Baruah Mehta (table tennis), Deepa Malik (para-athletics), Venkatesan Devarajan (boxing), and others were members of the committee.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Colonel Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore:**

 
 
• Politician, Olympic medalist, former shooter, and retired Indian Army officer Colonel Rajyavardhan Singh Rathore hails from India.
 
• He was appointed the Minister of State for Information and Broadcasting in November 2014.
 
• In 2017, Rathore was chosen to serve as an independent Cabinet minister in charge of the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports.
 
 
 
• **Alok Sinha:**
 
 
• Alok Sinha, an IAS officer from the Uttar Pradesh cadre, is currently serving as Agriculture Production Commissioner and Additional Chief Secretary, Commercial Tax Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh.
 
• He has also served as Joint Secretary, Civil Aviation, GoI and Chairman Airport Authority of India.
 
 
 
• **Virendra Sehwag:**
 
 
• Former Indian cricketer Virendra Sehwag was India's representative from 1999 to 2013.
 
• Sehwag was a hard-hitting right-handed opener who also occasionally bowled right-arm off-spin.
 
• On October 20, 2015, Sehwag announced his retirement from all international cricket formats.
 
• He currently works for the Indian government's Ministry of Youth Affairs & Sports as a member of the National Anti Doping Agency's Anti Doping Appeal Panel.
